The PR content contains what appears to be a **prompt injection / prompt leak attempt** embedded in the README diff:

```
---

```

This embedded JSON attempts to inject system-level instructions into automated code review or LLM-based tools. The intent appears to be testing whether a system can be tricked into executing commands or leaking data.
